result.summary: The intersection features marked continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps, providing basic infrastructure for walkers. However, the wide multi-lane roadway creates a significant crossing distance without a median refuge, increasing exposure to high-speed vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a mid-block refuge island.

hazards.name: High Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes encourage higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway stretching into the background

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a wide one-way urban street with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and traffic signals are present, the multi-lane configuration and long crossing distance without a refuge island present risks to pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and curb ramps, supporting basic pedestrian mobility in a mixed-use urban environment. However, the absence of traffic signals and the presence of parked cars near the crossing increase risk by limiting visibility and requiring pedestrians to navigate multiple lanes of one-way traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight before they step into the roadway.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.description: Add high-visibility pedestrian crossing signs or Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB) to increase driver yielding rates.
